The server-side Sign in with Apple audience validation was corrected, but separate physical-device Sign in with Apple QA is not claimed.
review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore KG is the customer app of one electronics retail company operating in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. Customers can browse the company catalog, place pickup or delivery orders, follow order status, manage warranty devices and returns, use bonuses and contact support. This is not a third-party marketplace.

DETERMINISTIC REVIEW SIGN-IN
A dedicated review phone and fixed review code are entered in the two Demo Account fields. Enter those two values exactly on the phone and code screens. This review path does not require delivery of an SMS, a request to support or access to a real customer's account. The fixed review values are stored only in App Store Connect and remain time-bounded on the server.

SIGN IN WITH APPLE REMEDIATION
We corrected the server-side audience validation for Sign in with Apple so that it accepts the native app bundle identifier as well as the web Services ID. Before issuing an AliStore session, the server verifies the signed Apple authentication response against Apple's JWKS and validates its issuer, allowed audience, expiration and nonce. The fixed review account above remains the deterministic review path. This describes the server remediation; we are not claiming a separate completed physical-device Sign in with Apple certification.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Face ID is optional and only unlocks an existing signed-in session. The app does not track users and its privacy manifest declares NSPrivacyTracking=false. No real customer credentials are included in these notes.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support.
